waiting.title: 42070 6x6 All Terrain Tow Truck: the small gear inside the turned rear differential
waiting.what: A second correction to the published file, following the one you signed today. That one turned the rear differential’s casing half a turn. The small bevel gear inside the casing sits on the casing’s own pin and must turn with it, but it stayed where it was. Left there, it is held by the axle housing instead of the casing, so the rear axle’s two wheels can only turn against each other: the truck can’t roll, and the XL motor can’t drive it. The correction moves that small gear to the other side of the casing’s centre, where the casing’s pin now is, as in the middle differential.
waiting.effect: The drive (function 1) goes from not working to working: the motor turns both ways and moves all nine parts the function lists. Checked on that function alone; the whole set is checked when you sign.
waiting.confidence: High. It follows from the part itself: the small gear always sits on its casing’s pin. The worker looked at the middle differential, built the same way, and the gear sits in its casing as this correction puts it.

waiting.title: 8832 Roadster: the roll bar's two bracing axles
waiting.what: A correction to the published file, for the swinging arm and its shock absorber (function 2). The shock absorber’s top sits on the roll bar’s top axle, and the file draws it so. The roll bar is braced from the frame by two slanted axles, each running through a toggle joint at its foot and one at its head. The file draws each slanted axle 1 LDU beside its head toggle’s hole, so the bracing isn’t read: the roll bar swings back as the arm pushes the shock absorber up. The correction turns each slanted axle half a degree, so it runs through both its toggles’ holes. The roll bar is then braced, the arm swings, and the shock absorber gives. You said the top sits on the seat. The worker found the top already held, as drawn, once the roll bar is braced, so it isn’t moved.
waiting.effect: Function 2 goes from partly working to working: the arm swings up to the end of the shock absorber’s travel and comes back, and the roll bar stays. The other three functions are as before. The set is read from Kinebrick’s copy of the file in models/, which is the same as the published file; once you sign, the set reads the published file, so that the correction applies.
waiting.confidence: High for the bracing: an axle must run through both holes it is drawn in, and turned half a degree it does. The worker looked at steps 12 and 13 of the booklet: step 12 adds the two slanted axles, and step 13’s inset shows the shock absorber behind the seat. The scan doesn’t show clearly where its top sits.
